theater: 上敘利亞圖尼普與奧龍特斯河上游

battle.name: 第十一次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 上敘利亞圖尼普與奧龍特斯河上游
battle.brief: 約公元前1443年，埃及第十八王朝法老圖特摩斯三世統軍越西奈北征，在奧龍特斯河上游的圖尼普、哈馬特一線與受米坦尼支持的敘利亞聯盟交鋒，迫使聯盟諸邦歸附並繳納年貢。卡面這把埃及月牙劍此時已退居典禮與警衛佩兵，在近身格鬥與攻城破門中仍見其用。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是埃及新王國第十八王朝，與以米坦尼為核心的敘利亞—黎凡特聯盟。埃及一方以法老圖特摩斯三世為最高統帥，國王親率由王室成員與近衛構成的「神兵」車隊駐紮全軍中央；步兵主體為各郡徵集的埃及籍矛兵與弓手，在編制上隸屬軍隊書記官；車兵分王室直轄與各省供應的輕型雙輪戰車兩級；另有「梅德賈伊」這支由三角洲邊境與沙漠游牧民混編的精銳步兵，專任先鋒與警戒。軍需自孟菲斯沿尼羅河以船運抵卡爾納克與邊境口岸，再轉駱駝隊、驢車與牛車走西奈商道北運。聯盟一方並無統一統帥：圖尼普、哈馬特、阿勒頗、阿拉普、卡圖納等城邦各有國王與軍隊，名義上奉米坦尼的「偉大王」為宗主，實則各自為政，靠聯盟會議協調出兵；赫梯在安納托利亞方向施加壓力，使聯盟背後始終有第二股力量支撐。雙方在迦薩以北沒有固定邊界，爭的是阿姆吉走廊、黎巴嫩山地的雪松林，以及通往幼發拉底河上游的道路。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Egyptian New Kingdom of the Eighteenth Dynasty and a Syrian-Levantine coalition with Mitanni at its core. On the Egyptian side the supreme commander was Pharaoh Thutmose III, who led the host in person, with the divine escort, a body of charioteers drawn from the royal family and the household troops, stationed in the centre of the army. The infantry core consisted of spearmen and archers levied from the Egyptian nomes and placed under the army scribes; the chariotry was divided into royal chariots and light two-wheeled chariots supplied by the provinces; and there was the Medjay, a picked body of infantry recruited from the frontier of the Delta and from the desert nomads, employed as vanguard and as an outguard. Stores were shipped by boat from Memphis up the Nile to Karnak and to the frontier ports, then transferred to camel trains, donkey carts and ox carts along the caravan road through Sinai. The coalition had no single commander: Tunip, Hamath, Aleppo, Arqa, Qatna and other city-states each had their own king and army, nominally acknowledging the Great King of Mitanni as their overlord but in practice acting for themselves and coordinating their levies through a league council. Hatti applied pressure from the Anatolian side, so a second power always stood behind the coalition. There was no fixed frontier north of Gaza; what was contested was the Amorite corridor, the cedar forests of the Lebanon hills, and the road that led up to the Euphrates.
people: 法老圖特摩斯三世（Menkheperre）是全軍最高統帥，也是這場遠征的實際策劃者：他要在阿姆吉走廊之外打通一條穩定的軍路，把埃及的邊界推到奧龍特斯河上游，再沿幼發拉底河東岸建立攻勢。埃及方面記名於戰役年表的官員包括總管（維齊爾）瓦塞特、帕，以及步兵首領「雅」與車兵首領「阿」；圖特摩斯三世的兄弟瓦塞特、加納蒙、加瓦薩等多次隨軍，卡爾納克阿蒙神廟的祭司團亦隨侍在側，負責記錄年表與主持祭典。敘利亞方面的關鍵人物，是米坦尼王國的「偉大王」圖舒拉塔，以及他的兄弟阿塔舒馬拉；地方一線，圖尼普王卡埃姆瓦塞特、比布魯斯王傑達穆涅方克等人先後由對抗轉為向埃及靠攏，阿穆魯與雷圖努的部眾則是聯盟中最難整合的部分。卡爾納克神廟祭司與宮廷書記留下的年表，是今天唯一能確認這次遠征規模與去向的原始材料。
peopleEn: Pharaoh Thutmose III (Menkheperre) was the supreme commander of the entire army and the real planner of this expedition. He wanted a secure military road beyond the Amorite corridor, to push the Egyptian frontier up the Orontes and then open an offensive along the east bank of the Euphrates. The Egyptian officials named in the campaign annals include the vizier Weset, Pa, the commander of the infantry Ay and the commander of the chariotry A; Thutmose III's brothers Weset, Ganamun and Kawasa campaigned with him more than once, and the priestly college of Amun at Karnak attended the king, keeping the annals and conducting the rituals. On the Syrian side the key figure was Tushratta, the Great King of Mitanni, together with his brother Artashumara. Locally, the king of Tunip, Khaemwaset, and the king of Byblos, Djedamunefankh, swung from opposition to alignment with Egypt, while the peoples of Amurru and Retenu remained the hardest elements of the coalition to hold together. The annals left by the priesthood of Karnak and by the palace scribes are the only original material that fixes the scale and the direction of this expedition.
kits: 卡面這把埃及月牙劍（khopesh），是埃及遠征軍中仍留存的單兵砍刀：刃身外彎、只有一側開鋒，前段收成鉤狀，砍入之後不必回拔。圖特摩斯三世這一代，埃及步兵骨骸與墓室壁畫顯示，軍隊骨幹已是直刃雙鋒銅劍、銅矛與銅斧，弓手用木、角、象牙複合而成的埃及弓，拉力約一百二十至一百五十磅；月牙劍於是退居兩線：一是典禮佩兵，出現在祭祀、法老出行與神廟場景；二是駐防、警衛與近身格鬥，並在攻城時用來砍斷懸吊撞槌的纜繩、破壞門軸與射孔遮板。銅料來自西奈與東方進口，供應有限，一柄鋒利的月牙劍在窄盾陣的縫隙中連續劈砍，效率高於直刃。同時在役的還有輕型雙馬戰車，車上三人編制：御者、弓手、矛兵；以及圓盾、長方盾、投擲棒、青銅斧、鎚等。攻城靠撞槌、雲梯、木柵與坑道，不靠攻城塔；後勤用牛車、驢、駱駝與沿海船運，糧食為小麥、大麥、椰棗與葡萄酒。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card was the single-handed cutting blade that still remained in the service of the Egyptian expeditionary army: the blade curves outward, is sharpened on one edge only and tapers to a hook at the tip, so that once it has been driven in it does not need to be twisted out again. In the reign of Thutmose III, Egyptian skeletons and tomb paintings show that the backbone of the army was already the straight double-edged copper sword, the copper spear and the copper axe, while the archers used the composite Egyptian bow of wood, horn and ivory with a draw weight of roughly 120 to 150 pounds. The khopesh therefore fell back to two lines of use. First it was a ceremonial weapon, appearing in sacrifices, in royal processions and in temple scenes. Second it stayed in the hands of garrison troops, of guards and of close combat, and at sieges it was used to cut the ropes that suspended the battering ram, to break gate pivots and to split the boards that covered the arrow slits. Copper came from Sinai and from imports in the east and was scarce, so a well-kept khopesh, worked again and again in the narrow gaps of a shield wall, was more efficient than a straight blade. Also in service were the light two-horse chariots, crewed by three men, a driver, an archer and a spearman, together with round and rectangular shields, throwing sticks, copper axes and maces. Siege work rested on the ram, on scaling ladders, on timber palisades and on tunnels rather than on siege towers, and the rear was supplied by ox carts, donkeys, camels and coastal shipping, with wheat, barley, dates and wine as the food of the marching column.
tactics: 遠征按固定的季節程式運作：春末出師，圖特摩斯三世的年表常記「某王年某月出發」，多在四月前後；寧可趕在盛夏之前走完西奈與北敘利亞的乾旱地帶，也不願把車隊與糧隊拖進酷熱。行軍序列分三段：先行的是偵察與工程人員，沿途鑿井、平路、設營；主力是車兵加結盾步兵，兩翼配弓手；最後是運糧的牛車、驢車與隨軍工匠。攻擊時先以弓手齊射壓制，再由車兵突擊撕開缺口，步兵隨即以密集盾陣推進；遇到城池則圍而不急攻，轉而用封鎖糧道、外交分化聯盟成員的方法逼其轉投，埃及常以分賜恩典的方式把敵方城邦從聯盟中拉走。渡河與山道是全軍最脆弱的環節，車隊順序、旗幟與號角傳令、一日的行程都按固定節奏安排。撤退時的側翼警戒與水源保衛被視為決定成敗的關鍵，沙漠中一次斷水，足以讓整支遠征隊自行崩散。
tacticsEn: These expeditions ran to a fixed seasonal routine. The army set out in late spring, the annals of Thutmose III regularly recording the month in which the king departed in a given regnal year, and the departures cluster around the fourth month. The column preferred to finish the dry country of Sinai and northern Syria before the fierce heat of midsummer rather than drag the chariots and the baggage trains into it. The march was organised in three parts. Scouts and engineers went first to sink wells, level the track and establish the camps; the main body followed, chariots and shielded infantry in the centre with archers on the flanks; and last came the baggage train of ox carts and donkey carts together with the corps of craftsmen. An assault opened with a volley from the archers, the chariots charged to tear a gap, and the infantry advanced behind them in a dense shield wall. When a walled town was met it was surrounded rather than rushed: the Egyptians sealed the grain road and used diplomacy to break the coalition apart, and they were expert at pulling enemy cities out of the league by the grant of favour. Fords and hill tracks were the most fragile parts of the column, and the order of the chariots, the flags and trumpet calls and the distance covered in a day were all fixed in advance. On the march back, flank screening and the guarding of the water were treated as decisive: a single failure of the water supply in the desert could dissolve an expeditionary army on its own.
data: 可以引用的數字有幾組。第一是年代：圖特摩斯三世在位約為公元前1479至1425年，另一套換算法把即位點推到1446年，兩者相差二十年上下；本卡所列的公元前1443年落在其中一套年表的中段，若採低年代學換算，約當其王曆三十六年上下，不同年表算出的王年可能差上一兩年。第二是戰役次數：孟菲斯神廟牆上的年表記錄圖特摩斯三世二十二次遠征，是判定各次戰役的骨幹材料。第三是距離：自卡爾納克至美吉多約九百五十公里，至阿勒頗約一千一百公里，至幼發拉底河東岸的卡疊施約一千三百公里。第四是兵力：埃及全國人口約二百萬至四百萬，每次遠征實際拉得出來的步兵與弓手以萬計，車兵數百輛，連同糧隊與工匠可能達數萬人。第五是銅料：銅主要來自西奈與東方進口，供應緊張，劍與矛頭的數量遠低於兵員。第六是附屬體系：阿勒頗城堡石柱列出的貢賦名單裡有數十個敘利亞與黎凡特城邦名號，代表這場遠征之後被寫進埃及體系的附屬方數量。第七，阿瑪爾納信件反映當時敘利亞多地歉收，埃及曾以穀物回應米坦尼的請求，說明軍事的消耗最終轉嫁到糧食供應上。
dataEn: Several groups of figures can be quoted here. First, the dates: the reign of Thutmose III is reckoned from about 1479 to 1425 BC, while another chronology moves the accession to 1446 BC, a difference of some twenty years; the 1443 BC date used for this card falls in the middle stretch of one of these chronologies, and on the lower chronology it corresponds to about his thirty-sixth regnal year, though the regnal years computed from different chronologies may differ by a year or two. Second, the number of campaigns: the annals painted on the wall of the temple at Memphis record twenty-two expeditions of Thutmose III and form the backbone for the dating of each of them. Third, the distances: about 950 kilometres from Karnak to Megiddo, about 1,100 kilometres to Aleppo and about 1,300 kilometres to Qadesh on the east bank of the Euphrates. Fourth, the strength: the population of Egypt was perhaps two to four million, and the infantry and archers that a single expedition could raise ran into the tens of thousands, with several hundred chariots, and probably tens of thousands of men once the baggage train and the craftsmen are counted in. Fifth, copper: it came mainly from Sinai and from eastern imports and was in short supply, so the number of swords and spearheads fell far short of the number of men. Sixth, the system of dependencies: the tribute list on the stela from the citadel of Aleppo contains the names of several dozen Syrian and Levantine city-states, and so shows how many of them were written into the Egyptian order after this campaign. Seventh, the Amarna letters record that the harvests failed in many parts of Syria, and that Egypt answered Tushratta's requests with grain, which shows that the true cost of the war was finally carried by the food supply.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是邊界與地盤：埃及自圖特摩斯一世、圖特摩斯二世起就在黎凡特建立據點，向北推進到黎巴嫩山麓；米坦尼王國在幼發拉底河上游崛起，把阿勒頗、哈馬特、圖尼普、阿拉普、卡圖納等城邦收攏成聯盟，與埃及在阿姆吉走廊和奧龍特斯河谷撞在一起，爭的是同一條商路與同一片山口的控制權。第二層是體系之爭：聯盟想切斷埃及通往阿勒頗與卡疊施的道路，把埃及的邊界壓回迦薩；埃及則要保住已得的雪松林、港口與附屬城邦。第三層是宗主的角力：米坦尼需要把聯盟綁在自己身上，埃及則要讓阿穆魯與腓尼基諸城確認唯一的宗主是卡爾納克。卡爾納克神廟的祭司團有直接的經濟動機——遠征帶回的戰利品與新附屬地的貢賦，是神廟田產與金銀器物的來源，於是神廟在廷議中推動北征。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason. The outermost was frontier and territory. Egypt had held footholds in the Levant since Thutmose I and Thutmose II and had pushed north to the foot of the Lebanon; the kingdom of Mitanni had risen on the upper Euphrates and gathered Aleppo, Hamath, Tunip, Arqa and Qatna into a league, so that the two powers met in the Amorite corridor and in the valley of the Orontes, each contesting the same trade road and the same mountain passes. The second layer was a struggle between systems: the coalition wanted to cut the road from Egypt to Aleppo and to Qadesh and push the Egyptian frontier back to Gaza, while Egypt wanted to keep the cedar forests, the harbours and the dependent towns it had already won. The third was a contest between overlords: Mitanni needed to bind the league to itself, and Egypt needed the princes of Amurru and of Phoenicia to accept Karnak as their single lord. The priestly college of Amun at Karnak had a direct economic interest in the matter, for the plunder and the tribute of the newly dependent territories were the source of the temple's lands and of its gold and silver plate, and so the temple pressed for the northern campaign in the court.
impact: 這場遠征之後，埃及在敘利亞的體系換了一種樣子：不再只是搶奪城邑與雪松，而是建立一份長期的名冊，數十個城邦按年繳納貢賦，國王與地方貴族依名冊留下人質與聯絡，埃及派書記官進駐城邑，處理訴訟與收稅。邊界因此從迦薩推到奧龍特斯河上游與幼發拉底河東岸，埃及船隊沿黎凡特海岸巡弋，貿易線從尼羅河口直抵布魯特與西頓；反過來，敘利亞諸邦也借著這套體系進入青銅時代晚期最發達的外交網，阿瑪爾納書信裡往返的穀物、象牙、馬匹與禮品，都是這條通道上的貨。對武器史而言，這幾十年也是過渡期：月牙劍從更早時代的主戰砍刀退成典禮佩兵與警衛配備，銅矛、銅斧、埃及弓與三人乘員的輕戰車成為軍隊骨幹，埃及的戰爭從近身砍殺轉向弓箭、車陣與圍城三者並用。這種結構一直延續到第十八王朝末年，也餵養了後來阿瑪爾納時代那些規模更大的聯盟。
impactEn: After this expedition the Egyptian presence in Syria took on a different form. It was no longer a matter of seizing towns and timber but of keeping a long roll, with several dozen city-states paying tribute year by year, their kings and local notables kept on that roll as hostages in their own courts, and Egyptian scribes posted in the towns to hear suits and collect taxes. The frontier moved from Gaza up to the Orontes and the east bank of the Euphrates; Egyptian squadrons patrolled the Levantine coast, and the line of trade ran from the mouths of the Nile as far as Byblos and Sidon. In return the Syrian states entered, through that system, the most developed diplomatic network of the late Bronze Age, and the grain, the ivory, the horses and the gifts that passed in the Amarna letters all travelled on this channel. For the history of weapons these same decades were a period of transition: the khopesh, the principal cutting blade of the earlier age, became a ceremonial sword and a guard's sidearm, while the copper spear, the copper axe, the Egyptian bow and the light three-man chariot became the backbone of the army. Egyptian warfare had shifted away from hand-to-hand cutting towards the combination of arrows, chariot charge and siege. That structure lasted to the end of the Eighteenth Dynasty and fed the larger alliances of the Amarna age that followed.
result: 打完之後，聯盟沒有被解散，但被打散了主幹。埃及軍隊在奧龍特斯河谷與幼發拉底河上游一線站住，圖尼普、哈馬特一帶的諸王改以附屬名義續存，按名冊繳納貢賦與人質；米坦尼失去對阿勒頗方向的直接控制，退回幼發拉底河東岸，仍是東方最強的鄰邦，卻承認埃及在黎凡特的地位。埃及沒有把勢力伸進安納托利亞境內，也沒有攻下卡疊施的城；那裡留給了後來拉美西斯二世與赫梯之間的卡疊施之戰。對圖特摩斯三世本人，這場遠征還有一層內政意義：把邊界推到遠處，國內的繼承糾紛就變成邊境處的小事。此後他沒有再組織大規模的敘利亞遠征，重心回到埃及本土、南方的努比亞與加冕典禮；月牙劍則留在神廟與王陵的浮雕和陪葬清單裡，成為法老權力的象徵多於實戰的武器。
resultEn: Afterwards the coalition was not dissolved, but its main body was broken up. The Egyptian army held its ground along the valley of the Orontes and on the upper Euphrates; the kings around Tunip and Hamath survived under the title of dependencies, paying tribute and hostages according to the roll; Mitanni lost direct control of the road to Aleppo and withdrew to the east bank of the Euphrates, remaining the strongest eastern neighbour while acknowledging the Egyptian position in the Levant. Egypt carried no power into Anatolia and did not take the city of Qadesh, which was left for the battle of Qadesh between Ramesses II and the Hittites in a later generation. For Thutmose III himself the expedition carried one more meaning, a domestic one: once the frontier was pushed far away, the succession disputes at home became a small matter to be settled on the frontier. He never mounted another large Syrian expedition, turning his attention back to Egypt, to Nubia in the south and to the rituals of accession; the khopesh remained in the reliefs of the temples and the royal tombs and in the lists of funerary offerings, a symbol of pharaonic power rather than a weapon of war.
